application_credentials.description: Easiest is **Home Assistant Cloud** account linking: cancel this dialog, make sure the `cloud` integration is loaded, and pick Home Assistant Cloud when adding Bold. Only enter your own credentials here if you have a custom OAuth client from [Bold]({request_url}), registered with redirect URI `{redirect_url}`.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Bold
reauth_confirm.description: Bold no longer accepts the saved login. Log in again to keep using your locks.

abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different Bold account than the one this entry belongs to.

no_gateway.message: {name} has no Bold Connect, so it cannot be operated remotely.

rate_limited.message: Bold refused the request: too many activations. Bold limits activations per user per day.

command_failed.message: Bold could not operate the lock ({code}: {message}).

keep_active_unsupported.message: {name} does not support keeping the lock active.

keep_active_in_past.message: The keep-active time must be in the future.

ble_error.message: The Bold Connect could not reach {name} over Bluetooth. The signal between Connect and lock is probably too weak; move the Connect closer to the door.

gateway_unreachable.message: The Bold Connect of {name} is offline or unreachable.

firmware_outdated.message: {name} needs a firmware update in the Bold app first.

data_description.scan_interval: Lock status (Bold Elite) and battery come from polling. Lower is faster but makes more calls to Bold; minimum 30.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Activates the lock, optionally keeping it active (open) until a given time. Keeping active needs a lock with keep-active mode.

keep_active_until.name: Keep active until
keep_active_until.description: Keep the lock active until this moment. Leave empty for a normal activation.
